events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, the music, and the legend. What's your ultimate Woodstock track?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, who would have been 91, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll today. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55, was fatally shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today. His influence on hip-hop and music culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84, passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: The album cover that launched a thousand imitations. 'Abbey Road' from The Beatles, a true masterpiece.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: You know the drill. Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A message that still resonates today.

events.title: Original iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod portable music player on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed how we listen to music forever with the original iPod. Still got yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Celebrating 007
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Which 007 film or actor is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86, was born on this day.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the musical genius and peace activist, John Lennon, on what would have been his 86th birthday.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: A masterpiece of musical diversity. The Beatles' 'White Album' always sparks debate – what's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80, passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal album that redefined The Beatles' sound. 'Rubber Soul' continues to influence music to this day.
